sources.title: The role of sleep in cognition and emotion
sources.relevance: SFSR hypothesis — REM simultaneous forgetting of emotional charge and remembering content

sources.title: REM sleep de-potentiates amygdala activity to previous emotional experiences
sources.authors: Van der Helm E, Yao J, Dutt S, Rao V, Saletin JM, Walker MP
sources.relevance: Human fMRI evidence of REM-dependent amygdala activity reduction for emotional stimuli; NE (low gamma) as mediator

sources.title: Sleeping with fear: theta phase relationships between the amygdala and hippocampus during REM sleep
sources.authors: Totty MS, Bhimani S, Bhatt DL, Bhimani R, Bhimani K
sources.relevance: LA-VH theta phase difference predicts fear extinction memory (r=0.954); 180° antiphase = successful extinction

sources.title: Sleep Is for Forgetting
sources.relevance: Theoretical framework: REM theta-phase reversal in hippocampal place cells (LTP→depotentiation); LC silence during REM as NE zero mechanism

sources.title: Infralimbic activity during REM sleep facilitates fear extinction memory
sources.authors: Hong J, Choi K, Fuccillo MV, Chung S, Weber F
sources.method: calcium imaging + closed-loop optogenetics + fear conditioning
sources.relevance: 76.6% IL pyramidal neurons peak during REM; 4h critical window; NMDA-dependent intrinsic excitability increase; active IL role in REM emotional healing

sources.title: Memory-enhancing properties of sleep depend on the oscillatory amplitude of norepinephrine
sources.authors: Kjaerby C, Andersen M, Hauglund N, Untiet V, Dall C, Sigurdsson B, Ding F, Feng J, Li Y, Weikop P, Hirase H, Nedergaard M
sources.method: fiber photometry (GCaMP6f in LC neurons + GRABNE2m NE sensor in mPFC) + EEG/EMG
sources.relevance: NE infraslow oscillations ~30s period (0.034 Hz) during NREM; NE descent drives spindles; REM = sustained low NE state; NE oscillatory amplitude shapes sleep microarchitecture and memory

sources.title: Emotional Memory Processing during REM Sleep with Implications for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
sources.authors: Rho YA, Sherfey J, Vijayan S
sources.relevance: 4-12 Hz theta specificity for IL-amygdala fear extinction; 4 Hz optimal; non-theta ineffective; PTSD conditions: 4 Hz fails, 10 Hz works

sources.title: REM sleep reduction leads to fear overgeneralization via negatively modulating prefrontal theta oscillations
sources.authors: Di T, Liu J, Liu W, et al.
sources.method: randomized controlled trial (126 participants) + fear conditioning + fMRI + skin conductance + subjective ratings
sources.relevance: Late-night (REM) deprivation = fear overgeneralization comparable to total SD; 44% of REM protection mediated by dlPFC theta; effect persists 1 week

sources.title: Transient reactivation of small ensembles of adult-born neurons during REM sleep supports memory consolidation in mice
sources.authors: Srinivasan S, Koyanagi I, Vergara P, et al.
sources.method: Ca2+ imaging (miniaturized microendoscope, cfos-dependent GCaMP6s) + optogenetics + fear conditioning
sources.relevance: ~3 adult-born neurons (ABNs) in DG sufficient for REM-dependent fear memory consolidation; theta phase-locking essential; NREM manipulation ineffective

sources.title: Activity of norepinephrine-containing locus coeruleus neurons in behaving rats anticipates fluctuations in the sleep-waking cycle
sources.note: Abstract only (classic historical paper, sufficiently cited in review literature)
sources.relevance: Classic demonstration of LC near-complete silence during REM sleep
